Subject: Take‑home packet: inference assignment + reviewer slotting

Hi Alexandra —

Thanks again for interviewing with the Infra team last week. As discussed on the call, attached is the take‑home assignment we use to evaluate system design and inference optimization thinking. We keep the task intentionally time‑boxed (4–6 hours recommended) — please aim to submit by end of day Thursday, 18 Sep.

What's attached / links:
- inference_takehome_v2.pdf (PDF) — problem statement and starter data
- Google Drive: example artifacts and evaluation rubric (link below)

Logistics:
- Submission format: a short writeup (PDF/MD) plus any scripts or sample outputs packaged as a single zip.
- Where to submit: reply to this thread with your attachment, and I'll upload to the candidate folder in GH (we'll also pull into the panel inbox).
- Reviewers: Neha (hiring manager) and Grace (senior infra) will do the scorecard review; Marissa will coordinate calibration.

If you have any Qs about the prompt or need a minor accommodation on timing, tell us and we'll try to flex.

Best —
Sean Gallagher
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
Attachment: inference_takehome_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
